notes: This reads as an Entertainment hangout at first, but that genre's own boundary sends it here: reaching the monkey-and-sign landmark and the two kids pays off with objectives — deliver two burgers, complete the obby — so it is Adventure, with Obby & Platformer named second for the obby section. Shape is world-open because the intake answer says the obby is a section of the same map players fly across to, which rules out P4 and hub-portals; I took the Exploration preset on that shape and added the picks the prompt states outright, with collectible-nodes as the two burgers, npc-population as the two kids (both counts stated as 2 and recorded here since the schema holds no count field), and building-interior for the food store with the playable arcade inside it. That interior is what earns P3 — a store you buy from and an arcade you play are plainly indoors rather than facades — and path-track from the secondary genre brings P6 for the obby section, whose platform spacing has to be physics-legal even though Obby is not leading and its genre-wide P6 therefore does not follow it into the mix. Deciding without a user: I dropped winner-zone because the goal answer says players just return to the playground with no reward needed, sized the playground as a whole park per the scale answer, and left the flying ride itself in notes rather than forcing an option row, since no loaded file has one and treating it as a teleporter would contradict the stated flight; P3 is not a ready route today, so if it has to ship now the store becomes a facade and the arcade moves outdoors.
